title: OFSCP DM Message Create Request (v0.1)
description: Body of POST /api/federation/dms/{dmId}/messages (§8.3): a single DM delivered by the sender's client to the recipient's home provider. The provider MUST reject the request when {dmId} does not equal the id derived from {sender, recipient} (§7.4). The body has no type field: a type it carries is ignored, and the stored message has type message.

clientMessageId.description: Client-chosen idempotency key. Providers MUST treat (author, dmId, clientMessageId) as idempotent (§7.1).

to.description: The recipient actor (§7.4). When present the provider MUST verify it is local and that {dmId} derives from (author, to).

mentions.description: Actors the message mentions (§5.3). When present it is authoritative for mention notifications (§10.1).

reference.description: A reply's parent (§7.4 Replies). Absent provider means the parent is held by this (the recipient's) provider, which checks that it resolves to a message in the same conversation; a provider naming another provider MUST be the home provider of one of the conversation's participants (400 otherwise), and the parent is not checked.
